primary.title: The Compendious Book on Calculation by Completion and Balancing
primary.author: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi
primary.rationale: Al-Khwarizmi's seminal work on algebra, which introduced systematic methods for solving linear and quadratic equations. It is a foundational text in mathematics.

primary.title: The Book of Algebra and Almucabola
primary.author: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi
primary.rationale: This is another common title for his foundational work on algebra, often used interchangeably with 'The Compendious Book on Calculation by Completion and Balancing'.

primary.title: On the Calculation with Hindu Numerals
primary.author: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi
primary.rationale: This work is credited with introducing the Hindu-Arabic numeral system and the decimal system to the Western world through Latin translations.

secondary.title: Al-Khwarizmi: The Beginnings of Algebra
secondary.author: Ahmed Djebbar
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive study of al-Khwarizmi's life and work, focusing on his contributions to algebra and his impact on mathematical history. Written by a prominent historian of Islamic mathematics.

secondary.title: The Mathematics of Al-Khwarizmi
secondary.author: A.S. Saidan
secondary.rationale: An academic analysis of al-Khwarizmi's mathematical treatises, providing context and detailed explanations of his methods and innovations.

secondary.title: Al-Khwarizmi and the Algebra of the Arabs
secondary.author: F. Woepcke
secondary.rationale: While older, Woepcke's work is a foundational scholarly analysis of al-Khwarizmi's algebra, often cited in later scholarship. However, the prompt requested 1976 or later. A more recent work would be preferred if available.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are primarily known through Latin translations, making direct access to original Arabic manuscripts challenging. The listed titles are common English translations. Secondary sources are selected for their scholarly depth and focus on al-Khwarizmi's mathematical contributions.
